sentences.text:
Opposite Party :- State Of U.P. And 2 Others Counsel for Applicant :- Rajendra Singh Yadav Counsel for Opposite Party :- G.A.
Hon'ble Subhash Chandra Sharma,J.
Heard learned counsel for the applicants as well as learned A.G.A. for the State and perused the material placed on record.

This anticipatory bail application (under section 438 Cr.P.C.) has been moved seeking bail in Complaint Case No.2054 of 2017, under Section 498A, 323, 504 I.P.C. & Section 3/4 D.P. Act, Police Station Mahila Thana Rakabganj, District Agra, during the pendency of trial.
It is submitted by learned counsel for the applicants that the applicants are innocent and have been falsely implicated in the present case.
No offence is made out from the allegation made against them.

It is also submitted that since the offences said to have been committed are punishable with Vijay Kumar Gupta And 3 Others vs State Of U.P. And 2 Others on 16 May, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/51033805/

sentences.text: less than 7 years, therefore, a direction be given to learned trial court to make disposal of the bail application in light of the Satender Antil's case.
Learned A.G.A. opposed the prayer as aforesaid.

Considering the facts and circumstances of the case, submissions made by learned counsel for the applicants as well as learned A.G.A. and perusal of record, it is directed that, if applicants appear and move bail application before the learned court concerned within a period of 30 days from today,
the same shall be decided by it as expeditiously as possible in the light of latest law as laid down by the Hon'ble Supreme Court in the case of Satender Kumar Antil Vs. Central Bureau of Investigation and another LL 2022 SC 577 decided on 11.07.2022.
